description: Return ONE JSON OBJECT with exactly initial and current. Each list MUST contain exactly THREE facts in this order: object, relation, robot. This requirement applies separately to INITIAL and CURRENT. Combine all visible objects into the object fact. Include an initial robot fact even when the robot has not moved. For unclear or hidden details, explicitly say unclear or not visible; never invent observations. Use ids I1,I2,I3 for initial and C1,C2,C3 for current. Every fact has exactly id, category, text, views. Allowed views are head, wrist_left, wrist_right. text must describe image evidence; views must list at least one panel. Do not decide success. Required skeleton: {"initial":[{"id":"I1","category":"object","text":"replace with visible objects","views":["head"]},{"id":"I2","category":"relation","text":"replace with initial spatial relation or uncertainty","views":["head"]},{"id":"I3","category":"robot","text":"replace with initial robot evidence or not visible","views":["wrist_left"]}],"current":[{"id":"C1","category":"object","text":"replace with visible objects","views":["head"]},{"id":"C2","category":"relation","text":"replace with current spatial relation or uncertainty","views":["head"]},{"id":"C3","category":"robot","text":"replace with current robot evidence or not visible","views":["wrist_left"]}]}. Replace every placeholder with observations; retain all six entries.
judgment: Output format reminder: return ONE JSON OBJECT with exactly fact_checks and checks. fact_checks is a nonempty list of objects with id, source_ids, status, evidence, views. source_ids must refer to the provided description IDs; status is supported, corrected, or unresolved. Use views only from initial_head, initial_wrist_left, initial_wrist_right, current_head, current_wrist_left, current_wrist_right. checks has exactly goal_satisfied, released, objects_consistent, robot_structure_consistent. Every check is an object with value (yes, no, uncertain), evidence_ids (fact check IDs), reason. A yes/no check must cite at least one supported/corrected fact. An uncertain check may cite unresolved evidence. Do not add a decision field. Do not assume success or invent visible evidence. Every checks entry MUST be a nested object, NEVER a bare yes/no/uncertain string. Example JSON structure (replace observations and values according to the images): {"fact_checks": [{"id": "V1", "source_ids": ["I1", "C1"], "status": "unresolved", "evidence": "<state visible comparison or why unclear>", "views": ["initial_head", "current_head"]}], "checks": {"goal_satisfied": {"value": "uncertain", "evidence_ids": ["V1"], "reason": "<explain image evidence or uncertainty>"}, "released": {"value": "uncertain", "evidence_ids": ["V1"], "reason": "<explain image evidence or uncertainty>"}, "objects_consistent": {"value": "uncertain", "evidence_ids": ["V1"], "reason": "<explain image evidence or uncertainty>"}, "robot_structure_consistent": {"value": "uncertain", "evidence_ids": ["V1"], "reason": "<explain image evidence or uncertainty>"}}}. Do not copy placeholders. For a yes/no value, cite a supported or corrected fact rather than an unresolved fact.
